_comment: Makeup look selection. Chosen BEFORE the focal point, and combined with it. 'intensity' is a per-step multiplier applied on top of the chosen style variation inside styleIntensity() - it is the single hook that makes the look affect the written guidance, the 'amount to apply' meter, the application-quality band, the reference guide and the AR try-on at once. Every multiplier is <= 1.00 on purpose: 1.00 is the existing, already-tuned rendering maximum, so no look can ever render heavier than the system does today. That is what keeps the result realistic and stops it looking like a beauty filter. 'guide' is the sentence appended to a normal step; 'focalGuide' replaces it when that step is the user's selected focal point, so Makeup Look + Focal Point work together.

guide.lips: keep the colour soft and controlled - one thin, even layer, blotted once so it reads polished rather than glossy.
guide.blush: a light, neutral flush only - just enough colour to look awake under office lighting.
guide.eyebrows: fill only the sparse gaps and keep the front soft, so the brows look naturally neat.
guide.contour: a whisper of shadow under the cheekbone, blended until no line is visible at all.

focalGuide.lips: your lips lead this look, so define the edge cleanly with a neat outline, then fill one even layer. Polished and controlled - never bold or dramatic.
focalGuide.blush: your cheeks lead this look, so place a soft, even flush right on the apple and blend it out completely. No visible edge, no strong colour.
focalGuide.eyebrows: your brows lead this look. Fill evenly through the body, keep the front feathered, and tidy the line under the arch so the shape reads neat and professional - never drawn on.
focalGuide.contour: your contour leads this look, but keep it clean: shade the hollow lightly and buff the edges away completely, so the face looks structured rather than sculpted.

guide.lips: a soft, flattering wash of colour pressed in from the centre outward, so the lips look naturally full.
guide.blush: a warm, natural flush on the apples, blended upward so the skin looks lit from within.
guide.eyebrows: brush the hairs upward and fill lightly, so the brows frame your face without any hardness.
guide.contour: a soft shadow under the cheekbone, blended until it only suggests structure.

focalGuide.lips: your lips lead this look. Press the colour in from the centre and blend the outer edge softly, so it looks full and flattering rather than drawn on.
focalGuide.blush: your cheeks lead this look. Build a soft, warm flush on the apples and sweep it gently toward the temple for a naturally glowing finish.
focalGuide.eyebrows: your brows lead this look. Define the arch softly and fill through the body, keeping every stroke hair-like so the shape stays flattering and natural.
focalGuide.contour: your contour leads this look. Shade the hollow and jaw softly, then blend upward, so the face reads gently defined and never carved.

guide.lips: build the colour up richer in two layers, pressing the second layer in so it stays saturated and even.
guide.blush: a stronger, well-blended flush swept high along the cheekbone for a lifted, glamorous finish.
guide.eyebrows: define the arch and tail clearly, filling the body fully while keeping the front softer.
guide.contour: shade the cheekbone and jaw more deeply, then blend the transition so the definition stays smooth.

focalGuide.lips: your lips carry this look. Outline the shape fully, then build the colour in two layers for a rich, glamorous finish - keep the edge sharp and clean.
focalGuide.blush: your cheeks carry this look. Build the colour up on the apples and sweep it high toward the temple, blending the edges so the flush reads bold but still smooth.
focalGuide.eyebrows: your brows carry this look. Fill the body fully, define the arch and tail with a clear line, and keep the front blended so the shape is strong but never blocky.
focalGuide.contour: your contour carries this look. Build the shadow deeper through the hollow and along the jaw, then blend the top edge thoroughly so the sculpting stays believable.

guide.lips: the lightest wash of colour - dab it on with your fingertip so it only tints the lips.
guide.blush: the smallest touch of colour on the apples, blended out until it looks like a natural flush.
guide.eyebrows: brush the brows into shape and fill only where hair is actually missing.
guide.contour: the faintest shadow under the cheekbone, blended right out. Skip it entirely if it starts to show.

focalGuide.lips: your lips lead this look, but keep it simple: one sheer wash of colour patted in from the centre. Fresh and natural, nothing bold.
focalGuide.blush: your cheeks lead this look. Tap a small amount onto the apples and blend it out fully, so it reads as your own healthy colour.
focalGuide.eyebrows: your brows lead this look. Brush them up, fill only the gaps with light hair-like strokes, and leave the shape natural - no hard lines.
focalGuide.contour: your contour leads this look, but keep it barely there: a light shadow in the hollow, blended completely so it only softens the face.
